summary: Comprehensive testing of P2 features for German Meal Planner. All backend APIs (12/12 tests passed) and frontend UI components are fully functional. Features tested: Meal plan templates (save/apply/delete), Copy week to next week, Print-friendly recipe view, Nutrition tracking page.

issues: Console warnings: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for DialogContent - accessibility improvement recommended

passed_tests: GET /api/mealplan-templates - Lists all templates
POST /api/mealplan-templates - Saves current week as template
POST /api/mealplan-templates - Rejects empty week (400)
POST /api/mealplan-templates/{id}/apply - Applies template to week
DELETE /api/mealplan-templates/{id} - Deletes template
DELETE /api/mealplan-templates/{id} - Returns 404 for nonexistent
POST /api/mealplans/copy - Copies week to another week
POST /api/mealplans/copy - Rejects empty source week (400)
GET /api/nutrition/daily - Returns nutrition for date
GET /api/nutrition/daily - Returns zeros for empty date
GET /api/nutrition/daily - Correct response structure
GET /api/recipes/{id} - Returns recipe for print view
Frontend: Vorlagen button opens template list dialog
Frontend: Als Vorlage button opens save template dialog with name input
Frontend: Kopieren button opens copy week dialog
Frontend: Nährwerte nav link works and page loads
Frontend: Nutrition page shows weekly averages and daily breakdown
Frontend: RecipeDetail has Drucken button
Frontend: RecipePrint page loads with multiplier options (0.5x-4x)
Frontend: RecipePrint shows Zutaten and Zubereitung sections
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: DialogContent components missing aria-describedby for accessibility (console warnings)
Note: Nutrition values show 0 because recipes don't have nutrition data populated - this is expected behavior per agent context
seed_data_creation: Test templates created during testing were cleaned up. Existing template 'Testwoche' preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: P2 features fully implemented and tested. Meal plan templates allow saving/applying/deleting weekly plans. Copy week copies current week to next week. Nutrition tracking page shows weekly averages and daily breakdown (values are 0 because recipes lack nutrition data). RecipePrint page provides print-friendly view with portion multiplier. Background sync with IndexedDB queue implemented in service-worker.js but not tested (requires offline testing).
